title: Past-Due Disability Compensation from Favorable Rating Decisions
content:
**Qualifying decisions.** A qualifying decision is a favorable rating decision that grants service connection, an increase, individual unemployability or SMC (k) and whose effective date makes payable an entitlement month whose monthly payment had already been issued when that decision was made; a favorable decision made before the month it first makes payable was paid is not a qualifying decision.

**Release.** Past-due Disability Compensation from qualifying decisions is released once as one retroactive payment that cites the most recent qualifying decision, when no incarceration adjustment applies to the months covered. It applies when no direct-pay fee agreement is on file and no debt is in active collection, so nothing is withheld from it.

**Span.** Its span runs from the first entitlement month made payable by the earliest qualifying decision through the last entitlement month whose monthly payment was issued before the most recent qualifying decision was made.

**When the amount is fixed.** The past-due for a favorable rating decision is not fixed until the past-due additions owed for dependents recorded on the award's most recent dependency claim have been released.

**Business effect.** One retroactive payment entry is booked on the award, linked to the rating decision given and covering the span of entitlement months given, issued on the day it is made and deposited to the payment account on the award. The amount deposited equals the gross amount; the payment history shows the release under that decision, and the award's delivered total rises by that amount.

**Invocation.** The representative unlocks the agent tool `release_decision_past_due_fbf191c5` and calls it with:

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `award_id` | Reference number of the veteran's Disability Compensation award, as shown on the award record returned by the compensation award lookup | Identifier |
| `decision_id` | Reference number of the rating decision whose past-due amount is released, as shown on that decision in the award's rating-decision history | Identifier |
| `retro_period_start` | First entitlement month the release covers | YYYY-MM, as the months appear on the award's payment entries |
| `retro_period_end` | Last entitlement month the release covers | YYYY-MM, as the months appear on the award's payment entries |
| `gross_amount` | Total past-due amount released, US dollars | Positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign or thousands separator |
| `review_level` | Authorization the release carries | `single_signature` — one authorizer releases it on their own signature; `second_signature` — the release needs a second authorizer's signature before it goes out |

**Receipt.** Status "past_due_released", the reference number of the new release entry, the decision as given, the first and last months covered (YYYY-MM), the issue date (YYYY-MM-DD), gross and net amounts (US dollars, 2 decimal places, equal to each other) and the authorization level as given.

**Qualifying or not (hypothetical decisions)**

| Decision | Monthly payment for the first month it makes payable | Qualifying |
|---|---|---|
| Increase granted 15 May, effective 1 January | February, already issued on 1 March | Yes |
| Service connection granted 2 March, effective 20 February | March, not yet issued when decided | No |
